title: The Sales Type column is off by default, first in the list and remembered
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • You have never changed the columns of Sales By Representative since the release.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Representative is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the report's columns.
  2. Open the column selector.
  3. Turn Sales Type on and close the selector.
  4. Sign out, sign in again and open Sales By Representative.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: there is no Sales Type column.
  • Step 2: "Sales Type" is first in the list and is off.
  • Step 3: a Sales Type column shows after Status; it holds words only (no money).
  • Step 4: the Sales Type column is still on.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S5-R19, S5-R20, S5-R21, S5-R22, S5-R24, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), page 4 (cited by the story), export read 19 Oct 2026, used for on-screen labels; the look itself is checked in the "Design — how it looks" cases. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R19: “An invoice row carries a "Sales Type" column, after Status, reading "Labor", "Parts", "Part Sales" or "Labor, Parts".”
  • S5-R20: “The Sales Type column is offered in the report's column selector, first in its list.”
  • S5-R21: “The Sales Type column is off by default on screen, for every user.”
  • S5-R22: “A user who turns the Sales Type column on keeps it on for later visits.”
  • S5-R24: “The Sales Type column holds no money, so the report's existing rules for who may see money apply to the other columns unchanged.”
